name: Chao ngheu
summary: Cháo nghêu is clam porridge for the start of the day: rice porridge, sea clams, ginger, scallion, and rau răm.
origin: Hoi An. The Hoi An World Heritage conservation centre’s 4 September 2024 article, republishing Dân Việt, places the bowl at the beginning of the morning.
howToEat: Eat it hot, with a spoon.
The article does not name a topping beyond the clams, ginger, scallion, and rau răm.
where: Hoi An. A street and the hour are Check on arrival.
